# Third-Party Dependencies

[English](#english) | [Turkce](#turkce)

<a id="english"></a>
## English

`lvgl` is a submodule of [lvgl/lvgl](https://github.com/lvgl/lvgl), pinned to
v9.6.0 at `80ca777e37a2b176770726a02e07a6fb79ef0b39`.

Run `git submodule update --init --recursive` from the repository root.
The build does not download dependencies; demos, examples and ThorVG are disabled.
Update instructions are in the root README.

License: [lvgl/LICENCE.txt](https://github.com/lvgl/lvgl/blob/80ca777e37a2b176770726a02e07a6fb79ef0b39/LICENCE.txt).
Additional notices: [lvgl/COPYRIGHTS.md](https://github.com/lvgl/lvgl/blob/80ca777e37a2b176770726a02e07a6fb79ef0b39/COPYRIGHTS.md).
